report_title: Comprehensive Geospatial Directory of Major Indian Public Sector Enterprises: Oil & Gas, Power, Steel, Mining, and Heavy Engineering (2026 Edition)

summary.note: Full 546-location dataset referenced as psu_master_directory_2026.json was not included as a separate attachment in the source PDF; only a partial excerpt (134 entries) was shown, transcribed in master_directory_excerpt.json.

coordinate_reference_system: WGS84, decimal degrees to 4 decimal places

source_hierarchy_tiers.source_class: Official company annual reports, investor presentations, integrated reports (FY2023-24 through FY2025-26)
source_hierarchy_tiers.typical_examples: ONGC Annual Report 2025-26, NTPC Investor Meet 2025
MoPNG Project Monitoring Dashboard, MoP SAUBHAGYA portal, Rajya Sabha Starred Questions

source_hierarchy_tiers.source_class: State pollution control board consent orders, environmental clearance letters
source_hierarchy_tiers.typical_examples: EC for GAIL Jagdishpur-Haldia pipeline, HPCL Visakh Refinery expansion EC

source_hierarchy_tiers.source_class: Google Earth historical imagery, OpenStreetMap, Bhuvan satellite data
source_hierarchy_tiers.typical_examples: Visual identification of storage tanks, switchyards, mine pits

source_hierarchy_tiers.source_class: Industry directories, press releases, and RTI responses
source_hierarchy_tiers.typical_examples: SAIL Durgapur Steel Plant RTI reply, BEL Pune unit address on website

coordinate_accuracy_tiers.typical_criteria: Surveyed plant centroid from official map or environmental clearance lease boundary; on-ground measurement by field team (e.g., BHEL Haridwar, SAIL Bhilai)
Google Earth imagery aligned with company-provided site plans; distinct infrastructure visible (tank farm, stack, cooling tower)
Address geocoding with rooftop-level match; mining block centroid from CMPDI reports
Remote or newly commissioned sites with only taluk-level address; awaiting RTI response

entity_resolution_notes: ONGC Uran (Uran Gas Processing Complex) and ONGC Navi Mumbai were merged under ONGC_URAN (lat: 18.8850, lon: 72.9400).
IOCL Panipat Refinery and IOCL Panipat Terminal were kept as distinct locations because their operations are functionally separate and the sites are over 3 km apart.
NTPC Dadri (thermal and gas) was treated as a single location NTPC_DADRI since the two plants share a contiguous footprint.

For Coal India Limited, individual subsidiaries (SECL, MCL, NCL, WCL, ECL, BCCL, CCL, NEC) were indexed under the CIL_ prefix to reflect unitary corporate governance while retaining mine-level coordinates.
NHPC power stations and POWERGRID substations were captured at the point of interconnection with the grid.
known_gaps_and_discrepancies: CPCL Manali Refinery expansion II: no post-commissioning satellite imagery available as of July 2026; coordinates based on parent refinery centroid and may need adjustment.

POWERGRID ±800 kV HVDC Raigarh-Pugalur-Trichur corridor: 13 repeater stations along the 1,800-km route could not be geolocated due to security restrictions; listed with approximate linear-referencing coordinates flagged status: approximate.
Coal India subsidiaries' abandoned mines: only active mines per CIL's Annual Report 2025-26 are included; legacy mines under closure plans omitted unless rehabilitation is ongoing.
NHPC's projects in Jammu & Kashmir and Arunachal Pradesh: some pre-construction sites (Dibang Multipurpose Project, Pakal Dul) have only survey-camp coordinates, carrying low confidence.

BEL's manufacturing units: exact coordinates of BEL's Electronic Warfare and Avionics unit at Korwa (Uttar Pradesh) are obscured for strategic reasons; mapped to nearest public road intersection with 2-km radial uncertainty.

SAIL Visvesvaraya Iron & Steel Plant coordinate discrepancy: the working dataset lists 12.98N, 77.59E (near Bangalore), while the actual facility is at Bhadravati, Karnataka (~13.84N, 75.70E). Requires correction.
HPCL and BPCL terminal listing duplication: identical depot coordinates appear under both HPCL and BPCL prefixes for certain coastal terminals; joint verification of ownership needed.
stated_limitations: Temporal staleness: directory reflects a snapshot as of 31 March 2026.
Defence offsets: BEL and certain ONGC offshore platforms are subject to coordinate obfuscation for national security; provided coordinates are public-domain approximations only.
Urban retail stations: only company-owned major terminals and depots (>5,000 KL storage) are included for IOCL, HPCL, and BPCL, not the hundreds of retail fuel stations.
Pipeline routes: only compressor stations, intermediate pigging stations, and dispatch terminals of cross-country pipelines are mapped; linear pipeline paths are not covered.
